 Malaysia’s ex-PM transferred to house arrest for 1MDB graft sentence
 Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak has been transferred from prison to his Kuala Lumpur home to serve the remainder of a reduced six-year sentence under house arrest. He was convicted of misappropriating public funds in the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal.
